targets.quote: This Regulation establishes guidelines for the development of a trans-European transport network consisting of a comprehensive network and of a core network and extended core network
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: The overall objective of the development of the trans-European transport network is to establish a single multimodal Union wide transport network of high quality.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: the completion of a core network by 31 December 2030
targets.label: target

targets.quote: the completion of an extended core network by 31 December 2040
targets.label: target

targets.quote: the completion of a comprehensive network by 31 December 2050
targets.label: target

targets.quote: promotion of zero and low emission mobility in line with the relevant Union CO2 reduction targets
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: enabling greater use of more sustainable modes of transport, in particular by further developing an interoperable long-distance rail passenger network, including at high speed, and an interoperable rail freight network
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: the deployment of alternative fuels recharging and refuelling infrastructure, thereby contributing to the deployment of decarbonisation technologies
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: the development of green, sustainable and climate resilient infrastructure, taking into account active modes, and the promotion of new technologies that aim to decarbonise the construction of transport infrastructure
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: enables, without special permission, the operation of freight trains with a train length of at least 740 m (including the locomotive or locomotives)
targets.label: target

targets.quote: designed for a speed of at least 160 km/h for passenger trains on the passenger lines of the extended core network
targets.label: target

targets.quote: Member States shall ensure that any new railway line of the core network and the extended core network, including connections referred to in Article 14(1), point (d), provides for the European standard nominal track gauge of 1 435 mm.
targets.label: target

targets.quote: ERTMS is equipped on the railway infrastructure of the extended core network by 31 December 2040 and the comprehensive network by 31 December 2050
targets.label: target

targets.quote: Member States shall ensure that the railway infrastructure of the core network, the extended core network and the comprehensive network is equipped with radio-based ERTMS by 31 December 2050.
targets.label: target

targets.quote: the adoption and monitoring of a sustainable urban mobility plan (SUMP) for each urban node that includes inter alia measures to integrate the different modes of transport and shift towards sustainable mobility, to promote efficient zero and low emission mobility including urban logistics
targets.label: target

targets.quote: by 31 December 2030, the development of multimodal passenger hubs to facilitate first and last mile connections
targets.label: target

targets.quote: Member States shall make all appropriate efforts to improve the security and resilience of the infrastructure to climate change, natural hazards, hybrid threats, human-made disasters, accidents, and operational interruptions
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Projects of common interest for which an environmental impact assessment must be carried out in compliance with Directive 2011/92/EU shall be subject to climate proofing.
targets.label: commitment
